Lighting Security and Fire The QVIS Story Built on quality, driven by innovation, committed to servicing you. At QVIS Lighting & Security, everything we do is guided by four core principles: Quality, Versatility, Integrity, and Service . These values shape how we design, develop, and deliver our solutions. From engineered LED luminaires and intelligent lighting controls to cutting-edge security systems, every product is created with our customers at the centre. Our strength lies in our versatility — delivering seamless integration, scalable systems, and tailored solutions that adapt to real-world needs. We listen, we innovate, and we deliver with integrity. It’s this commitment that has earned the trust of industry professionals and fostered long-term partnerships that continue to define QVIS today. Want to learn more? Quality ISO accredited, UK assembled and made in Britain registered. Maintaining the commitment to purchasing LED drivers and lighting controls from recognise brands and continuously improving luminaire capabilities, whilst producing the highest lumen efficacy achievable. Versatility A commitment to offering lighting solutions and not a ‘one product fits all’ approach- with luminaire flexibility around design requirements, through selectable power and colour temperatures, to RAL colour alterations and sensor integration. Integrity Treated with the upmost importance and through clear communication
